title: On Selecting the strongest of the three
subtitle: 竞技体育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 竞技体育（文学艺术与体育·竞技体育与赛事）
meta: 主题语境：竞技体育（文学艺术与体育·竞技体育与赛事）　|　核心词汇：select　|　正文 354 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 select 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1982 the craftsman ① selected the strongest of the three with great care, and every apprentice in the workshop said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the craftsman ② selects the strongest of the three on the same day without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ select the strongest of the three at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ selected the strongest of the three before — a line in the ledger for August 1976 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Selecting the strongest of the three with great care, the craftsman said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the tool at the far bench, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ select four boys for the county games on the same day, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Select four boys for the county games at once and never mention it again.

By 1989 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the ledger, and a new apprentice from the next workshop ⑧ selects four boys for the county games with great care every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the bench, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ selected the strongest of the three again when nobody else would.

⑩ To select the strongest of the three, my mother said in 1994, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the workshop remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the workshop forgets, somebody selects the strongest of the three on the same day again and somebody must select the strongest of the three with great care all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 挑选（一般过去式 selected the strongest of the three：1982 年匠人头一回这样做，小心翼翼地）
B. v. 挑选（一般现在 selects the strongest of the three：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 挑选（不定式 to select the strongest of the three：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 挑选（过去完成时 had selected the strongest of the three：1976 年八月的工料簿上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 挑选（动名词 selecting the strongest of the three 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 选拔（select four boys for the county games：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去选拔为县里的赛事选出四个孩子）
G. v. 选拔（select four boys for the county games：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 挑选（后段两处：新来的学徒照例 selects four boys for the county games，而母亲又一次 selected the strongest of the three）

answers.why: select 意为“挑选”，1982 年匠人小心翼翼地挑选挑了三者中最结实的一个，那是工坊里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 selected。
select 意为“挑选”，自那以后匠人当天就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 selects。
select 意为“挑选”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯挑选挑了三者中最结实的一个”，此处为不定式 to select the strongest of the three。
select 意为“挑选”，工料簿里 八月 那行字说明早在 1989 年之前就有人挑选过，故用过去完成时 had selected。
select 意为“挑选”，匠人说“挑选挑了三者中最结实的一个这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 selecting the strongest of the three 作主语。
select 意为“选拔”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去选拔为县里的赛事选出四个孩子”，should ever 之后用原形 select four boys for the county games。
select 意为“选拔”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻选拔为县里的赛事选出四个孩子（select four boys for the county games at once），以后再也不要提起。
select 意为“挑选”，新来的学徒每个年头都照例选拔为县里的赛事选出四个孩子，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 selects。
select 意为“挑选”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次小心翼翼地挑选挑了三者中最结实的一个，用一般过去式 selected 叙述。
select 意为“挑选”，结尾那句是母亲 1994 年的话：要挑选挑了三者中最结实的一个，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和工坊记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 select 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1982 the craftsman selected the strongest of the three with great care, and nobody in the workshop forgot it.
Even now the craftsman selects the strongest of the three on the same day whenever the workshop asks.
Selecting the strongest of the three with great care, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever select four boys for the county games on the same day, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new apprentice from the next workshop selects four boys for the county games with great care every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother selected the strongest of the three again, and the workshop remembered that half.
